heading: Copies of acts and resolutions in slip form; additional number printed for Committee on the Judiciary of House of Representatives

versions.heading: Copies of acts and resolutions in slip form; additional number printed for Committee on the Judiciary of House of Representatives

lines.text: The Director of the Government Publishing Office is directed to print, in addition to the number provided by existing law, and, as soon as printed, to distribute in such manner as the Committee on the Judiciary of the House of Representatives shall determine, twenty copies in slip form of each public Act and joint resolution.
